title: End of Bolden's career and what became of the band
summary: Bolden stopped playing a couple of years before losing his mind and being taken to Jackson, dying around 1909. Jones does not know who led the band afterward; he remembers Frankie Dusen as a player.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
